description.en: The view from the watchtower: its railing, the torch and the horn, the telescope, the roofs of the village, the palisade and its gate, the river in the dale, the wood where the wolves live, the packman on the road, thunder over the fells and fog in the dale.
description.sl: Razgled s stražnega stolpa: ograja, bakla in rog, daljnogled, strehe vasi, palisada in njena vrata, reka v dolini, gozd, kjer živijo volkovi, krošnjar na cesti, grom nad hribi in megla v dolini.
description.it: La vista dalla torre di guardia: la ringhiera, la torcia e il corno, il cannocchiale, i tetti del paese, la palizzata e il suo portone, il fiume nella valle, il bosco dove vivono i lupi, il venditore ambulante sulla strada, il tuono sui monti e la nebbia nella valle.
description.de: Der Blick vom Wachturm: sein Geländer, die Fackel und das Horn, das Fernrohr, die Dächer des Dorfes, die Palisade und ihr Tor, der Fluss im Tal, der Wald, in dem die Wölfe leben, der Hausierer auf der Straße, Donner über den Bergen und Nebel im Tal.

words.example_en: From the watchtower you can see the whole dale.
words.example_sl: S stražnega stolpa vidiš vso dolino.
words.example_it: Dalla torre di guardia si vede tutta la valle.
words.example_de: Vom Wachturm aus sieht man das ganze Tal.
words.note: Watch + tower: a tower to watch from. Jack keeps watch up here at night.
words.note_sl: Watch (stražiti) + tower (stolp). Jack tu gori ponoči straži (keeps watch).
words.note_it: Watch (sorvegliare) + tower (torre). Quassù Jack fa la guardia (keeps watch) di notte.
words.note_de: Watch (Wache halten) + tower (Turm). Jack hält hier oben nachts Wache (keeps watch).

words.note: Hold on to the railing: with on to.
words.note_sl: Hold on to the railing: drži se ograje, z on to.
words.note_it: Hold on to the railing: tieniti alla ringhiera, con on to.
words.note_de: Hold on to the railing: halt dich am Geländer fest, mit on to.

words.example_en: Jack lights the torch at dusk.
words.example_it: Jack accende la torcia al crepuscolo.
words.example_de: Jack zündet in der Dämmerung die Fackel an.
words.note: In Britain a torch is also a little lamp with a battery (Americans say flashlight). The plural: torches.
words.note_sl: V Britaniji je torch tudi žepna svetilka na baterije (Američani rečejo flashlight). Množina: torches.
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna torch è anche la torcia elettrica a pile (gli americani dicono flashlight). Il plurale: torches.
words.note_de: Im Britischen ist torch auch die Taschenlampe (Amerikaner sagen flashlight). Der Plural: torches.

words.example_en: Blow the horn if you see wolves!
words.example_sl: Zatrobi na rog, če vidiš volkove!
words.example_it: Suona il corno se vedi i lupi!
words.example_de: Blas ins Horn, wenn du Wölfe siehst!
words.note: Blow the horn. A car has a horn too: beep beep!
words.note_sl: Blow the horn: zatrobiti na rog. Tudi avto ima horn (hupo): bip bip!
words.note_it: Blow the horn: suonare il corno. Anche l'auto ha un horn (il clacson): bip bip!
words.note_de: Blow the horn: ins Horn blasen. Auch ein Auto hat ein horn (eine Hupe): tüt tüt!

words.note: Old sailors called it a spyglass. You look through it.
words.note_sl: Stari mornarji so mu rekli spyglass. Gledaš skozenj: through.
words.note_it: I vecchi marinai lo chiamavano spyglass. Ci guardi dentro: through.
words.note_de: Alte Seeleute nannten es spyglass. Man schaut hindurch: through.

words.example_en: The roofs of the village are grey slate.
words.example_sl: Strehe v vasi so iz sivega skrilavca.
words.example_it: I tetti del paese sono di ardesia grigia.
words.example_de: Die Dächer im Dorf sind aus grauem Schiefer.
words.note: The plural is roofs, not rooves (but leaf, leaves; knife, knives).
words.note_sl: Množina je roofs, ne rooves (ampak leaf, leaves; knife, knives).
words.note_it: Il plurale è roofs, non rooves (ma leaf, leaves; knife, knives).
words.note_de: Der Plural ist roofs, nicht rooves (aber leaf, leaves; knife, knives).

words.example_en: The palisade goes all round the village.
words.example_it: La palizzata gira tutto intorno al paese.
words.example_de: Die Palisade geht rund um das ganze Dorf.
words.note: A wall of pointed wooden stakes, to keep the wolves out.
words.note_sl: Zid iz koničastih lesenih kolov, da volkovi ne pridejo noter.
words.note_it: Un muro di pali di legno appuntiti, per tenere fuori i lupi.
words.note_de: Eine Wand aus spitzen Holzpfählen, damit die Wölfe draußen bleiben.

words.note: A gate is in a wall or a fence; a door is in a house. On the fells, always shut the gate behind you!
words.note_sl: Gate je v zidu ali ograji, door v hiši. Na hribih vedno zapri vrata za seboj!
words.note_it: Il gate è in un muro o in un recinto, la door in una casa. Sui monti chiudi sempre il cancello dietro di te!
words.note_de: Ein gate ist in einer Mauer oder einem Zaun, eine door im Haus. In den Bergen das Gatter immer hinter dir schließen!

words.example_en: The river runs down the dale to the lake.
words.example_sl: Reka teče po dolini do jezera.
words.example_it: Il fiume scende lungo la valle fino al lago.
words.example_de: Der Fluss fließt durch das Tal zum See.
words.note: In Cumbria a small river is a beck.
words.note_sl: V Cumbrii majhni reki rečejo beck.
words.note_it: In Cumbria un piccolo fiume si chiama beck.
words.note_de: In Cumbria heißt ein kleiner Fluss beck.

words.example_en: The wolves live in the wood.
words.note: A wood is a lot of trees, smaller than a forest; wood with no a is what trees are made of.
words.note_sl: A wood je gozd, manjši od forest; wood brez a pa je les.
words.note_it: A wood è un bosco, più piccolo di una forest; wood senza a è il legno.
words.note_de: A wood ist ein Wald, kleiner als ein forest; wood ohne a ist das Holz.

words.example_en: Our village is at the top of the dale.
words.example_sl: Naša vas je na zgornjem koncu doline.
words.example_it: Il nostro paese è in cima alla valle.
words.example_de: Unser Dorf liegt oben im Tal.
words.note: Dale: the old northern word for a valley, from the Vikings' dalr: Borrowdale, Langdale.
words.note_sl: Dale: stara severnjaška beseda za dolino, od vikinške dalr: Borrowdale, Langdale.
words.note_it: Dale: la vecchia parola del Nord per valle, dal vichingo dalr: Borrowdale, Langdale.
words.note_de: Dale: das alte nordenglische Wort für Tal, vom Wikingerwort dalr: Borrowdale, Langdale.

words.example_en: Two wolves at the edge of the wood!
words.example_it: Due lupi al margine del bosco!
words.note: The f becomes ves: one wolf, two wolves; one knife, two knives.
words.note_sl: F postane ves: one wolf, two wolves; one knife, two knives.
words.note_it: La f diventa ves: one wolf, two wolves; one knife, two knives.
words.note_de: Aus f wird ves: one wolf, two wolves; one knife, two knives.

words.example_en: The packman has buttons, needles and ribbons.
words.example_sl: Krošnjar ima gumbe, šivanke in trakove.
words.example_it: Il venditore ambulante ha bottoni, aghi e nastri.
words.example_de: Der Hausierer hat Knöpfe, Nadeln und Bänder.
words.note: The plural is packmen, like man, men. He carries his little shop on his back from village to village.
words.note_sl: Množina je packmen, kot man, men. Svojo malo trgovino nosi na hrbtu od vasi do vasi.
words.note_it: Il plurale è packmen, come man, men. Porta il suo negozietto sulle spalle di paese in paese.
words.note_de: Der Plural ist packmen, wie man, men. Er trägt seinen kleinen Laden auf dem Rücken von Dorf zu Dorf.

words.example_en: First the lightning, then the thunder.
words.example_it: Prima il lampo, poi il tuono.
words.example_de: Erst der Blitz, dann der Donner.
words.note: Count the seconds from the lightning to the thunder: three seconds is about one kilometre.
words.note_sl: Štej sekunde od bliska do groma: tri sekunde so približno en kilometer.
words.note_it: Conta i secondi dal lampo al tuono: tre secondi sono circa un chilometro.
words.note_de: Zähl die Sekunden vom Blitz bis zum Donner: drei Sekunden sind etwa ein Kilometer.

words.example_en: The fog lies in the dale like a lake.
words.example_sl: Megla leži v dolini kot jezero.
words.example_it: La nebbia sta nella valle come un lago.
words.example_de: Der Nebel liegt im Tal wie ein See.
words.note: Fog is thick; mist is thin. It's foggy: there's fog.
words.note_sl: Fog je gosta megla, mist redka. It's foggy: megleno je.
words.note_it: Fog è la nebbia fitta, mist quella leggera. It's foggy: c'è nebbia.
words.note_de: Fog ist dichter Nebel, mist leichter Dunst. It's foggy: es ist neblig.

words.example_en: Lightning over the crags! The storm is near.
words.example_sl: Strela nad pečinami! Nevihta je blizu.
words.example_it: Un fulmine sulle rupi! Il temporale è vicino.
words.example_de: Ein Blitz über den Felsen! Das Gewitter ist nah.
words.note: Lightning has no plural: a flash of lightning. Thunder is the boom after it.
words.note_sl: Lightning nima množine: a flash of lightning (blisk). Thunder je grom, ki pride za njim.
words.note_it: Lightning non ha plurale: a flash of lightning (un lampo). Thunder è il tuono che viene dopo.
words.note_de: Lightning hat keinen Plural: a flash of lightning (ein Blitz). Thunder ist der Donner danach.
